The largest bone in the human body is the femur.

Regarding the effectiveness of the described physical therapy technique, Myofascial Release (MFR) is generally considered effective for treating myofascial pain syndrome. By applying gentle, sustained pressure to the fascia, MFR aims to release restrictions in the connective tissue, which can help alleviate pain and improve range of motion. Clinical evidence supports its use for reducing muscle tension and improving mobility in patients with chronic pain conditions, although individual results may vary based on the severity of the condition and the skill of the therapist.
